styles.name: supernova
styles.description: Supernova shockwave shell explodes outward; radius = eased * max; debris halos outside

styles.name: pulsar
styles.description: Pulsar: neutron star spins twin lighthouse beam cones; a radio pulse trace below records ticks out to eased

styles.name: nebula-clouds
styles.description: Nebula: billowing dithered gas cloud with a dark dust lane and twinkling newborn stars; lit extent = eased

styles.name: big-bang
styles.description: Big-bang singularity explodes: all particles radiate outward, position scales with eased

styles.name: solar-flare
styles.description: Solar flare: a plasma loop with racing knots arches off the Sun's curved limb; loop height and span = eased

styles.name: aurora-curtains
styles.description: Aurora curtains: vertical sine-sheet columns ripple via time; extent = eased

styles.name: meteor-shower
styles.description: Meteor shower: bright-headed streaks with tapering tails rain across the stars; count and horizon fill with eased

styles.name: total-eclipse
styles.description: Total eclipse: the dark Moon slides across the round Sun; corona streamers flare out at totality

styles.name: grav-lens
styles.description: Einstein ring arc: background dots deflect around a central mass; ring radius = eased

styles.name: cosmic-web
styles.description: Cosmic web: node galaxies connected by filaments appearing as eased grows; nodes pulse

styles.name: redshift
styles.description: Redshift: a receding spiral galaxy's light wave stretches toward the observer; spectral line slides redward with eased

styles.name: quasar-jet
styles.description: Quasar: edge-on accretion disc around a blazing nucleus fires twin jets with streaming knots; jet length = eased
